name: Earth Monarch
description: (Tag:earth)(Tag:earth-resistance+)You are the Earth Monarch, ruler of all Earth; your durability is massively enhanced, as you are as immovable as earth. All your Earth and Metal-related abilities below Mythical Tier are increased by one rank and cost less energy. All earth-aligned beings instinctively recognize you as Monarch, and you are immune to earth and metal-based abilities.
